gold.question: A lack of conformity in goods covered by Directive (EU) 2019/771 becomes apparent eight months after delivery. What does Article 11(1) presume, and when does that presumption not apply?
gold.reference_answer: It presumes that the lack of conformity existed at delivery, including for goods with digital elements, unless the contrary is proved or the presumption is incompatible with the nature of the goods or the nature of the lack of conformity.
key_facts: 1. Any lack of conformity which becomes apparent within one year of the time when the goods were delivered shall be presumed to have existed at the time when the goods were delivered, unless proved otherwise or unless this presumption is incompatible with the nature of the goods or with the nature of the lack of conformity. This paragraph shall also apply to goods with digital elements.
